title.es: Cómo Elegir el Piso Adecuado para su Proyecto Comercial en 2025
title.fr: Comment Choisir le Bon Revêtement de Sol pour Votre Projet Commercial en 2025

excerpt.en: A comprehensive guide to selecting commercial flooring based on traffic, moisture, budget, and design requirements.
excerpt.ar: دليل شامل لاختيار الأرضيات التجارية بناءً على حركة المرور والرطوبة والميزانية ومتطلبات التصميم.
excerpt.es: Una guía completa para seleccionar pisos comerciales según tráfico, humedad, presupuesto y requisitos de diseño.
excerpt.fr: Un guide complet pour sélectionner le revêtement de sol commercial selon le trafic, l'humidité, le budget et les exigences de conception.

body.en:
Flooring is one of the most important decisions in any commercial project. The right choice can last decades; the wrong one can lead to costly replacements within years.

## Key Factors to Consider

### 1. Traffic Level
High-traffic areas like retail stores and hotel lobbies need AC4 or AC5 rated laminate, or durable SPC flooring.

### 2. Moisture Exposure
For kitchens, bathrooms, and basements, 100% waterproof SPC is the top recommendation.

### 3. Design Requirements
Engineered wood and parquet offer unmatched elegance for premium office spaces and luxury retail.

### 4. Budget
Laminate offers the best value for most commercial applications, while SPC provides the best durability-to-cost ratio.

## Our Recommendation
Contact our team for a free consultation. We'll help you choose the perfect flooring for your specific needs.
